From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@heliohealth.com>

Subject: Approval request: one-time bridging credits + 60-day eval runway for HelioHealth POC

Hi Jordan and Laura,

Quick ask — HelioHealth (Elena/Tom) are deep in a technical POC that validated model accuracy for a clinical triage workflow. They hit two blockers: (1) they exhausted the PLG trial credits faster than expected due to heavy embedding and eval runs, and (2) procurement needs a 60-day evaluation window before they can sign an MSA.

Current ask: one-time complimentary credits equivalent to $6k of usage and a 60-day extension to the POC window (today + 60 days). They’re a strong mid-market healthtech prospect with clearly articulated production intent (HIPAA scope, pilot will connect to a de-identified test dataset).

Why this should be approved:
- Pipeline motion: sales estimate $150k ARR in year 1 if pilot converts.
- Technical fit: our Redwood-verified latency/cost profile matches their requirements; this will produce a usable reference architecture for other health customers.
- Risk mitigation: we keep the extension behind a one-time SLA/cap on usage and require PO/commit-to-evaluate form.

Attachments: Helio_POC_Summary.pdf (quick summary + usage runbook).

Requesting: Jordan / Legal guidance on terms, and exec signoff for the one-time credit. If we can get an approval by Friday, I can have a short addendum + draft PO to Elena.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Rishi / Laura — forwarding Marcus’s note. TL;DR: HelioHealth asks for $6k one-time credit + 60-day extension to their PLG trial window. They’ve signaled clear procurement timeline and are willing to execute a short PO that references the evaluation addendum.

My read: high upside, low precedent risk if we make it one-off with a usage cap and require PO-draft + security checklist completion. Proposed guardrails:
- Credits capped and non-recurring (expire at term end)
- Extend eval for 60 days from today and lock in a conversion conversation 30 days before end
- Legal to confirm standard addendum language (no change to data handling or SLA)

Elena — adding you so you see our internal motion; will circle back with an addendum template once Rishi/legal OK.

-J
